_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.english_concept: special characters (Unicode symbols usable for decoration)
phrases.usage_guidance: The umbrella term for the whole symbol/decoration category on this site; use as the primary head term for library/collection pages and the ko/ homepage, exactly as already live.
phrases.good_example: 특수문자 모음 — 닉네임·프로필 꾸미기 복사 붙여넣기
phrases.avoid_when: Do not substitute a narrower synonym (기호, 이모티콘) where '특수문자' is already the established head term — would fragment ranking.

phrases.english_concept: nickname / username used across platforms and games
phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the general cross-platform concept of a chosen display name; for the specific @-handle field on a platform prefer '사용자 이름/아이디' (KO-011) to keep the display-name vs. handle distinction the site's own FAQs already draw.
phrases.good_example: 이름 꾸미기 ⋆｡˚ 닉네임 특수문자 — 인스타·틱톡·게임 복사
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use for the strictly @-prefixed handle field, which the same pages call '아이디' or '사용자 이름' instead.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use the full form '복사 붙여넣기' in titles/H1/meta for SEO completeness; the clipped colloquial '복붙' (see notes) is appropriate in body copy, button microcopy, and casual FAQ sentences.
phrases.good_example: 특수문자 모음 — 닉네임·프로필 꾸미기 복사 붙여넣기
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid the clipped '복붙' in a page's <title> or H1 — it reads casual there; keep it for body/FAQ sentences.

phrases.usage_guidance: The default register word for 'aesthetic' styling across this whole site (35 of 48 ko/ pages already use it) — safe as a primary style descriptor on font/decoration pages. Do not stack it with too many other mood synonyms in one heading.
phrases.good_example: 감성 글씨체 변환 — SNS 표시 이름·프로필 감성 글씨 복사
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid in legal/accessibility/technical explanatory sections (e.g. the box-rendering explainer) where a plain description reads more credible.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the specific product of the ireum-kkumigi (name decorator) generator and similar nickname-styling features; distinct from the plainer '닉네임 특수문자' which just names the ingredient (symbols), not the finished style.
phrases.good_example: 감성 닉네임이란, 일반 글자와 모양이 다른 유니코드 문자로 쓴 이름이나 닉네임을 말합니다.
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid on gaming-clan-tag or competitive-name contexts where 'Y2K 감성' or a more aggressive register fits better (see KO-030).

phrases.usage_guidance: The established H1/title term for the name-decorator generator feature itself (ko/ireum-kkumigi/); use for the tool/action, not as a synonym for the noun '닉네임' or '감성 닉네임'.
phrases.good_example: 이름 꾸미기
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — already the canonical page name for this feature; do not rename without a discussed exception per the site's own hub/spoke rules.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary title/H1 term for the pretty-font converter page; pairs naturally with '감성 글씨체' (KO-004 family) but is the more universally understood, less youth-slang variant — safe as a primary head term.
phrases.good_example: 예쁜 글씨체 변환 — aesthetic SNS 표시 이름·프로필 복사
phrases.avoid_when: n/a for general font-conversion contexts.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the neutral, tool-category term (borrowed English '폰트' + native '변환') — appropriate anywhere the site needs a plain, non-mood-coded label for the core generator, including CTA buttons ('폰트 변환 열기 →').
phrases.good_example: 폰트 변환 — 감성·예쁜 글씨체 생성기 (복사 붙여넣기)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is the plain/neutral variant, safe as a fallback anywhere a mood-coded synonym (감성/예쁜) would be too strong.

phrases.usage_guidance: The native term for 'cursive' style specifically (not a general aesthetic word); pairs with the borrowed English '커시브' in body copy for searchers who type the English loanword. Use '필기체' as the primary/canonical term.
phrases.good_example: 필기체 변환 — 영어를 필기체(𝒞𝓊𝓇𝓈𝒾𝓋𝑒)로 복사 변환
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: display name (as distinct from a platform's fixed @handle)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use precisely for the free-text display-name field whenever a page needs to draw the display-name-vs-handle distinction (this is a recurring, load-bearing distinction across the site's own FAQs) — do not blur it with '닉네임' when the handle-vs-display split actually matters to the answer.
phrases.good_example: 표시 이름이나 서버 별명을 유니코드 문자로 꾸미는 것은 지극히 정상적이고 허용된 사용 방식입니다.
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid using loosely as a synonym for '닉네임' in copy where the handle/display distinction isn't relevant — adds unneeded precision-jargon to casual sentences.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use whenever a page needs to warn that styling does NOT work on the handle field — every generator page on this site already carries this exact caveat; keep it precise, don't merge with '닉네임'/'표시 이름'.
phrases.good_example: 유일한 예외는 @로 시작하는 사용자 이름(아이디)으로, 그곳은 영문 소문자·숫자·마침표·밑줄만 됩니다.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this precision is exactly the point wherever it's used.

phrases.english_concept: checking whether a decorated name fits a game's character limit
phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the section label/H2 for a name-length checker tool or explainer; pairs naturally with specific per-game limits (see notes).
phrases.good_example: 꾸민 이름, 들어갈까? — 글자 수 확인
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: characters rendering as boxes/tofu due to missing glyphs
phrases.usage_guidance: Standard FAQ-answer framing across the site for the tofu/box-rendering problem; '네모' (square) with the box glyph '□' or '▯' is the consistently chosen visual + word pairing — keep both together for clarity.
phrases.good_example: 특수문자가 네모(□)로 보이는 이유는 무엇인가요?
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — this is already the house-style phrasing, reused verbatim across ko/index.html, yeppeun-geulssi, and insta-font FAQs.

phrases.english_concept: a character/name being rejected by a platform's filter
phrases.usage_guidance: Use in checker/warning microcopy when a symbol or name is likely to fail a platform's character filter, mirroring the site's own name-fit checker text.
phrases.good_example: 거부될 수 있어요 (허용되지 않는 문자)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for sections/pages specifically about making a blank-looking display name; pair with an explanation of WHY real spaces fail but certain invisible characters (U+3164, U+2800) succeed — this causal explanation is the actual value-add, not just the character list.
phrases.good_example: 투명 & 빈 로블록스 닉네임
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.english_concept: the specific invisible character used to fake a blank nickname
phrases.usage_guidance: Use specifically for U+3164 when explaining or offering the exact invisible-character workaround; always pair with the codepoint (U+3164) since the glyph itself is invisible and unsearchable without it.
phrases.good_example: 한글 채움 문자 (U+3164)
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Safe and natural in body copy, FAQ, and use-case lists once the platform has been named in full once on the page; use full '카카오톡' in titles/meta/first mention for clarity and search coverage of both forms.
phrases.good_example: 인스타·디스코드 프로필과 닉네임, 카톡, 댓글에 그대로 붙여넣을 수 있습니다.
phrases.avoid_when: Avoid using only the abbreviation in a page's very first platform mention (title/meta) — pair with the full form there.

phrases.english_concept: KakaoTalk's status-message field, a common decoration target
phrases.usage_guidance: Name this specific field explicitly (not just 'KakaoTalk profile' generally) whenever a page lists platforms special characters work on — it is a genuinely distinct, high-traffic surface in Korea with its own byte-based length limit.
phrases.good_example: 인스타그램 바이오와 이름, 카카오톡 상태메시지, 디스코드 닉네임과 서버명... 텍스트를 입력할 수 있는 곳이면 거의 어디서나 쓸 수 있습니다.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Genuinely distinctive, Korea-only vocabulary worth calling out explicitly as its own section/category (as the site already does) rather than folding into a generic 'kaomoji' bucket — the site's own copy correctly notes '한국에서만 통하는' (only used in Korea).
phrases.good_example: 한국에서만 통하는 한글 자모 이모티콘이에요. 얼굴 모양 대신, 자음·모음으로 웃음·울음·떨림 같은 느낌을 나타냅니다.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a for Korean-market copy; do not port this section's framing into other-locale pages, it is locale-specific by definition.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the umbrella term for face-shaped emoticons distinct from Hangul-jamo emoticons; the term is fully naturalized in Korean (loaned from Japanese via the same route as English) and both live Korean competitor tools (Toolvil.com) use it as their own category label.
phrases.good_example: (◕‿◕) ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ 같은 텍스트 이모티콘(카오모지)과 ㅋㅋ ㅠㅠ 한글 자모 이모티콘을 감정별로 모았어요.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Use to draw the precise distinction this guide is built around: decoration is fine, impersonation is the actual violation. Keep this word doing exactly that job rather than using it loosely for 'getting flagged' in general.
phrases.good_example: 이는 꾸미기의 문제가 아니라 사칭의 문제입니다.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the specific @-mention mechanic when explaining why decorated names can be hard to find/tag; a fully naturalized loanword requiring no gloss.
phrases.good_example: 디스코드의 @멘션 자동완성은 입력하는 대로 일반 문자를 대조합니다.
phrases.avoid_when: n/a

phrases.usage_guidance: A wholly uncaptured Korean gaming decoration surface — distinct from 닉네임 (KO-002) and 클랜 태그 (KO-017); worth its own section if ko/ireum-kkumigi/ or a future Lineage-specific page is built.
phrases.good_example: 문자칸에꺼 복사 붙여넣기 하시면 됩니다

phrases.usage_guidance: If ko/ game-specific coverage expands, Lineage (a decades-old, top-grossing NCsoft franchise) is a real gap — currently zero mentions across all 52 live ko/ pages.

phrases.english_concept: game with active decorated-nickname secondary market
phrases.usage_guidance: Real, well-evidenced game-specific angle distinct from KO-024's Discord-impersonation framing — a nickname-trading fraud context instead.

phrases.english_concept: telling real from fake lookalike special characters (nickname-trading context)
phrases.usage_guidance: Distinct FAQ angle from KO-024 (impersonation/lookalike-character warning) — this is specifically about nickname-trading fraud, not chat impersonation.

If ko/ ever covers per-game rules, list MapleStory explicitly as a 'does not support decoration' case rather than silently omitting it — matches the site's own 'check before you paste' ethos. Nothing to build here (there is no field to decorate).

phrases.english_concept: decorative Hangul respelling with lookalike glyphs from other scripts (dated style)
phrases.usage_guidance: Use descriptively/historically only — e.g. an FAQ explaining why Unicode cannot style Hangul and what Koreans did instead. Never as a title/H1 term and never as a product framing.
phrases.avoid_when: Do NOT treat this as a build brief on the strength of the ja/gal-moji precedent. Korean-language reference sources date the style to roughly 2001-2004 and describe present-day use as socially rejected; gal-moji's nostalgic-kawaii register does not transfer to 외계어. Any ko lookalike feature needs its own current-register evidence first.

phrases.english_concept: phone Text Replacement shortcut used as a personal symbol-combo store
phrases.usage_guidance: A genuinely Korean-specific closing move for a ko symbol page: '저장해서 텍대로 등록해두세요' rather than assuming the user bookmarks and returns. Also read it as a competitive fact — 텍대 is what substitutes for repeat visits in this market.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not present 텍대 as a UltraTextGen feature — it is an OS feature. And do not assume ko repeat-visit behaviour matches other locales; this phrase is evidence against that assumption.

phrases.english_concept: per-character enclosing-box decoration (combining enclosure), as a search formulation
phrases.usage_guidance: KakaoTalk-first, not Instagram-first — which is itself the ko signal. The documented manual method is exactly script.js's applyDecoration mode 'interleave' performed by hand, one character at a time.
phrases.avoid_when: Do NOT conflate with KO-013 (네모로 보이는 이유). Both use the 네모/box word but mean opposite things: this is a deliberate decoration, KO-013 is a rendering failure. Mixing them on one page would actively mislead.

phrases.english_concept: the @ sign — Korean everyday name, which fully displaced the English reading
phrases.register: neutral; used on broadcast news, in schools and in casual speech alike
phrases.usage_guidance: On a Korean @ page, '골뱅이' is the H1 term, with '앳(at)' and the formal '골뱅이표' named once in the body for completeness. Do not build the page around '앳' — that is the English reading with a Korean spelling and is not how the symbol is searched.
phrases.good_example: @ 기호는 한국에서 흔히 골뱅이 또는 골뱅이표라고 부릅니다.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use '골뱅이' in copy about @-mentions on Discord/Instagram — that mechanic is '멘션' (KO-026) and calling it '골뱅이' shifts the topic from the character to the shellfish. Do not use in a strictly technical/Unicode spec context, where '앳 사인' or the codepoint name is expected. Be aware a prescriptivist minority argues '@은 골뱅이가 아니고 앳' — acknowledge both names rather than asserting only one.

phrases.english_concept: 'emoji' vs 'emoticon' in Korean — the loanword trap where 이모티콘 does NOT mean emoji
phrases.register: neutral; 이모티콘 is the far more common word in Korean speech, but for a different referent
phrases.usage_guidance: Use 이모지 as the head term for any Korean Unicode-emoji page. Address 이모티콘 explicitly in one FAQ item ('이모지와 이모티콘의 차이') to capture the confused query and immediately disambiguate — that FAQ is the page's highest-value Korean-only section. Keep 카오모지 (KO-022) and the Hangul-jamo emoticons (KO-021) as separate, clearly labelled things.
phrases.good_example: 카카오톡에서 쓰는 그림은 엄밀히 말하면 이모지가 아니라 이모티콘(스티커)입니다.
phrases.avoid_when: Never use 이모티콘 as the title/H1 term for a Unicode-emoji copy-paste page — it promises KakaoTalk stickers, which this site does not and cannot provide. Do not use 이모지 for the ㅋㅋ/ㅠㅠ Hangul-jamo emoticons (KO-021) or for kaomoji (KO-022).

phrases.content_surface: feature naming (if a Hangul-native text-transform feature is ever built)
phrases.avoid_when: Never use in formal, technical, or accessibility-related copy; comedic/community-flavored contexts only

phrases.usage_guidance: Instagram-Highlight-cover-specific angle on invisible/blank characters, distinct from the generic KakaoTalk/gaming invisible-name use case already well covered.

KO splits the concept by PURPOSE, not by object: 특수문자 ("special characters") is the decorative/copy-paste register, 기호 ("sign/symbol") the technical-reference one. 하트 특수문자 draws 12,100/mo; the 기호 form is what 수학 기호 / 음악 기호 / 저작권 기호 use.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 특수문자 for a maths, music, currency or legal-symbol reference page — those take 기호 in Korean search.
